world: World: Pale Citadel of Souls, endless white walls and courtyards where lost souls wait; pale grey-blue stone, white marble, faint ghostly blue light; cold quiet colours.
ground: pale grey-blue stone paving made of SMALL irregular worn flagstones (each about a twentieth of the image), fine cracks, thin mortar lines and faint blue moss in the joints.
low: a sunken shadowed courtyard floor: darker blue-grey small worn cobbles with cracks, damp stains and faint wisps of blue mist; darker than the paving around it.
high: a raised white marble terrace: smooth pale marble in small square tiles with faint grey veins and fine wear; brighter than the paving below.
trail: a processional path of small pale sand-coloured cobblestones, worn smooth, tightly packed, with fine dust in the joints.
cliff: a tall retaining wall: a white stone coping along the top edge; below it, pale stone blocks with mortar lines and faint blue moss and stains.
